parameters.description: Location id(s) from `/autocomplete` (the `id` field), comma-separated  -  e.g. `dtdistrict09` (a district), `zoorchard` (an area), `sg-mrt-orchard` (an MRT). `singapore` (default) = the whole island. parameters.name: query_type
parameters.description: The *kind* of place in `query_ids`. Optional  -  leave it blank and it is auto-derived from the id prefix (recommended; works for nearly every id). Override only if you need to, using the `type` from `/autocomplete`: `district`, `zone`, `subway_station`, `cluster` (a project, street or landed group), or `city`. Location scoping only takes effect once this is set or auto-derived.
